'''Sniper CloneX4'''<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/thvnchpgjnn6q9fw99b33v8|text=ABB-FF-005706|date=2024-05-01}}</ref> was a [[Clone X trooper]] who was active<ref name="TCHA" /> during or after [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Sniper CloneX4, along with [[Sniper CloneX3]], [[Sniper CloneX5]], and [[Unidentified Clone X trooper|another Clone X trooper]], was activated by [[Doctor|Dr.]] [[Royce Hemlock|Hemlock]] to capture [[Clone Force 99]] who had infiltrated [[Tantiss Base]]. Sniper CloneX4, along with [[CX-2]], Sniper CloneX3, and Sniper CloneX5, encountered [[Hunter]], [[Wrecker]], and [[Crosshair]] within the ruined science hangar of Tantiss Base. The [[CX squad]] overpowered and captured the members of Clone Force 99. During the [[Skirmish on Wayland|final battle]], Sniper CloneX4 was killed by [[Echo]] and Wrecker with his comrades, except the last Clone X trooper who was killed by [[Vik (clone)|Vik]].<ref name="TCHA" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
The [[trooper]] Sniper CloneX4 wore [[armor]] similar to the ones worn by other members of [[CX squad]].<ref name="TCHA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sniper CloneX4 first appeared in "[[The Cavalry Has Arrived]]," the fifteenth and final episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[May 1]], [[2024]].<ref name="Watch">{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}}</ref> The character's name was never mentioned in the episode or its credits,<ref name="TCHA" /> but was identified in official promotional assets linked to the show released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] via [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]]. The image's caption, however, does not explicitly specify which [[Clone X trooper]]s are which.<ref name="Getty" />
